description: DOCS: search the RateAPI documentation (authentication, rate limits and pricing, coverage, freshness, methodology, eligibility, endpoint map, product parameters, errors, the MCP server itself, and the rules for quoting the data). Use this whenever the question is about the API rather than about a rate — "how do I authenticate?", "what does rate_phase mean?", "which endpoint gives deposit APYs?", "how fresh is this?", "what does it cost?" — instead of guessing at parameters or inventing endpoints. Returns ranked pages with an excerpt; call get_doc for the full text. This tool NEVER returns rates.

limit.description: Maximum pages to return (1-12). Defaults to 5.

query.description: What you want to know about the API, in plain words (e.g. "oauth", "how fresh are rates", "429 error").

name: search_docs

note.description: Guidance on what to do with these results.

results.description: Matching documentation pages, best match first.

excerpt.description: The first matching paragraph of the page.

score.description: Relevance score; comparable within one result set only.
